name: Kanban Board
description: A task board that survives real data: long titles, six assignees, a column with forty cards in it. Columns, drag between them, assignees, priority and progress per card. Pointer-based drag, so it works on a trackpad and a phone. More at layro.vercel.app
author: uvain
oQueDa: Kanban robusto (títulos longos, muitos responsáveis, coluna com 40 cards) com drag.
ondeVai: Pipeline comercial (Lead → Diagnóstico → Proposta → Fechado) e prazos por fase.
compat: React 19/Next 16/Tailwind v4: revisar 'use client', trocar framer-motion por motion/react quando aparecer; cores hardcoded → tokens do globals.css.
